effect: advance the pc by the instruction length; nothing else (the common tail every handler returns through)
inert: shares the invalid-opcode target 0025E60A (marks the tick finished and advances)
halt: set actor +14h bit 6 and rewind the pc, so the instruction repeats every tick
pop one value and discard it
logical OR: pop b, pop a (int, floats truncated), push (a != 0 or b != 0)
arithmetic shift right: push a >> b (sar)
add: int + int as int, otherwise float (addss)
subtract: int or float path (00267560 selects)
divide: int (idiv) or float (divss); a zero divisor is tested on both paths and yields 0; the float test is ordered (a NaN divisor divides) and INT_MIN / -1 is not tested
remainder: int idiv only, with NO zero test - MOD 0 faults; INT_MIN MOD -1 faults too, because nothing is tested before the idiv
inert (shares 0025E60A) - unary minus is not implemented
request: pop (channel, function id, actor) and file a kind-0, mode-1 request
request kind 0, mode 2 (start-wait: the requester parks as wait kind 4 until the target starts)
request kind 0, mode 3 (end-wait: parks until the target's function returns)
pop three values; no request is filed
return: retire the active entry, select the next pending one, and resume the caller's wait slot (or service the wait state when none is outstanding)
return N: pop a depth and recycle the entry range above it, then resume as RET
return and transfer: as RET, and start the next entry's script (003DBDC0)
wait for a request: pop (function id, actor); if that actor has the entry active, park as wait kind 3 on it
pop two values; no wait is armed
set an actor's resource-override slot: pop (value, actor, slot) into 0025AF60; slots 10h-11h re-arm the EH-5 countdown when the target's +0Bh bit 3 is set
cancel: pop an index and recycle the entry range above it (003DB420)
pop into per-actor int register I0 (record +64h)
pop one value and hand it to the ret-0 stub 0016D6A0 - inert
push a variable (resolved by descriptor; width and int/float from the descriptor)
pop into a variable, coerced to its kind
resolve a variable for the debug print path
push a variable reference (how an array element is passed)

push tag k of the actor the latest PUSHACT named: 02099AB8 selects entry (index + 1) x 16 of the slot's +80h table, [slot + 0] + its dword is that actor's tag table, dword [k x 8 + 8] is pushed (8000h past its count)
push the packed actor handle of the operand's actor index ((word << 16) | index | bit 14; 8000h when out of range)
push the int constant the operand indexes in the slot's pool (+68h)
push the float constant the operand indexes in the slot's pool (+70h)
jump to bytecode base + the script's jump table[operand]
pop v; jump if v == Y
pop v; jump if v > Y
pop v; jump if v >= Y
pop v; jump if v < Y
pop v; jump if v <= Y
pop two bounds, order them, jump if Y lies between them
call native verb [operand] with X = the actor's own index; if the verb yields, rewind and save the pc so the call repeats next tick
as CALL, but first pop the target actor into X (skipped while the context is resuming, +15h)
pop into X; jump if non-zero
pop into X; jump if zero (the for-loop idiom)
as CALL, and when the verb completes pop its result into register A
as CALLACT, and when the verb completes pop its result into register A
request on a whole actor list (waits while any listed actor still has the channel active)
wait on a whole actor list (wait kind 5)
peek three values (pop and push back) and mark the target's channel as requested (002659F0: +24h bit, +10h count) without filing a request
